summary.intent: Resolve a newly-posted Greptile automated review comment on PR #615 (cipher-box), fixing a bug in how ShareDialog derives/falls back on the item `kind` for shared nodes.
summary.outcome: Identified the bug as an instance of a known web `kind`-fallback issue, traced it through FileBrowser's resolveChildNodeIdentity and ShareDialog's handleShare, applied three edits to ShareDialog.tsx, verified with typecheck and lint, and committed the fix.

repo: There is a recurring 'kind'-fallback bug class in the web app's file-browser components where derived item kind (file/folder) can be wrong for shared/resolved nodes unless explicitly threaded through from resolveChildNodeIdentity.

ShareDialog.tsx consumes resolvedByIpnsName and a derived `kind` value that originates from FileBrowser.tsx's node identity resolution logic; handleShare's dependency array must be kept in sync with these values.

code.finding: Fixed to correctly derive/pass `kind` instead of relying on a fallback that produced wrong results for shared nodes flagged by Greptile; handleShare's useCallback dependency array was also updated as part of the fix.
Contains the kind derivation / resolveChildNodeIdentity logic that ShareDialog relies on for determining file vs folder identity of shared items.

workflow: Re-sweeping a PR for review comments mid-workflow can surface newly-posted bot comments (here, Greptile) even after prior CodeRabbit/other passes were already handled.
Before pushing, checked an earlier CI watch task output and the remote for bot commits to avoid clobbering concurrent changes.

open_items: Only the single new Greptile thread was addressed in this session; full reply-and-resolve-thread and push steps from the /resolve-pr-reviews workflow weren't shown as completed in the visible transcript.
